column6: What to expect on opening day
column7:
After a long winter in the workshop, we open the new season on the first Saturday in March. The doors open at nine, and the coffee machine runs from the first minute. Bring your bike along: our mechanics check brakes, gears, tyres and lights for free while you have breakfast with us in the courtyard.

Many of you asked for longer test rides last year, so this time we have planned three guided loops. The short loop follows the Elbe to the Blue Wonder bridge and back and takes about an hour. The medium loop climbs up to Loschwitz and rewards you with the best view over the river valley. The long loop leads out to Pillnitz Palace, with a break in the palace gardens before the ride home along the cycle route. Every loop starts at the shop, and you can ride any bike from our rental fleet, including the new cargo bikes.

For families, the children's corner offers balance bikes, a small skills course and a puncture repair class, where the kids fix a real inner tube and take home their own repair kit. In the afternoon, the local cycling club presents its spring tours and answers questions about group rides for beginners.

All season tickets for our workshop service are ten percent cheaper on opening day. If you plan a bigger repair, book a time slot in advance, because the first weeks of spring are always the busiest of the year. We look forward to seeing you and your bikes again.
